## Research status

**Technical owners.** 2 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Perception, Sensor Fusion, and Observation Trust](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/perception-sensor-fusion-and-observation-trust.html), [Embodied Agency, Real-Time Control, and Physical Safety](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/embodied-agency-real-time-control-and-physical-safety.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 3.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Simpler fusion and control systems with equal calibration, contradiction detection, latency, and recovery would justify a thinner trust model.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
